rule: Equal-weight eligible monthly folds; 0.4 dawn MAE + 0.4 dusk MAE + 0.2 daytime MAE. Minimum 30 targets per segment.
status: Retrospective development validation; folds overlap previously inspected data. October onward excluded from this selection. No fresh test or field accuracy claim.
deployment: Retain Random Forest: lowest rolling mean and worst-fold score, but near-tie with hybrid; no established statistically significant advantage.
